meta.title: Reasoning display enhancement
meta.description: Puts model reasoning into an inline reasoning box beside the Think row: a three-line preview, click to open the full body (up to 18 lines, shrinking for short content), click again to collapse; when thinking ends it settles back to the first line and collapses, one flourish per stream and never replayed for restored history. Reasoning reveal uses one fixed balanced cadence and the logarithmic fade stays on; both are skipped under OS reduced motion. The Think row switches between the translation and the original: the official reasoning-translation bundle chooses the service, or any registered DSH model route can be used; the translation channel offers a provider / model / reasoning-effort picker matching the composer model menu (provider groups, search, effort list), with selections staged and written only by the channel's Save. While streaming only finished fragments are translated and the tail stays original; historical reasoning blocks are always manual. The Plugins-page settings card is always expanded, no click needed: enabled, auto-follow reasoning, and the translation channel (backend, model route, target language, fragment limit, auto-translate; maxTokens / timeoutMs live in the translation.json seed only). enabled / thinkAutoExpand persist in the profile cordis.patch.yml entry and apply live; translation settings persist in ~/.dsh/think-box/translation.json. Enabling translation sends reasoning text to the selected service or model route; autoTranslate controls automatic sending; historical blocks stay manual. Tested on DSH 0.2.2-rc.5; requires >=0.2.2-rc.5 <0.3.0; the plugin depends on non-public seams (assistant-step swap, groupPart split, turnProcess fold, connection RPC, volatile config + configEditor) and must be regressed after upgrades. Translation covers the reasoning box only, not the answer. The full suite is 155/155 green with no skips.
